dogecoin.text: While Dogecoin is soaring to record-highs, one should not forget that it lacks technical development when compared to the likes of $BTC, $ETH and $LTC

Dogecoin to me is just like the previous ‘fidget spinner trend‘. The technology behind is not convincing enough to stay, the only one who will bring Doge to the moon is Elon. But don’t forget, you can’t survive on a Moon forever
Dogecoin definitely has a future,good or bad future?
